title: An edited vernacular medical compilation preserves a distinctive multi-source redaction plan
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: use an externally documented compilation's chapter splits, omissions, inversions and joins as a whole-book source signature, jointly with one global word code. Wellcome MS.617 supplies a concrete Italian Thesaurus/de-febribus/additions example; its later date and uncollated text prevent immediate Voynich selection.
source_facts: Wellcome's MS.617 catalogue dates the Italian manuscript to Venice, 1451. It joins Thesaurus pauperum, Tractatus de febribus and additions under continuing chapter numbers, then adds phlebotomy. The catalogue records omitted and added chapters, split eye and bladder/kidney topics, and an inverted fever sequence. These are institutionally documented source features, not producer image readings. The witness is later than the usual Voynich parchment date range and is evidence for an editorial mechanism, not an established exemplar.

design.unknown_decision: Can a single externally fixed redaction of several traditions explain complete source-specific passage order and concrete wording under one common key, rather than merely matching broad medical genres or isolated quotations?
design.architecture: Upstream source traditions feed one finite editorial plan: preserve, omit, split, transpose or append only where a collated historical witness licenses that exact operation. The output is that witness's actual vernacular text and complete ordered chapter inventory. A single bijection from distinct complete source orthographic words to complete admitted manuscript raw groups encodes every retained paragraph. Source transitions never reset the key. No invented translation, new synonym, word deletion, fragment filler or discretionary chapter rearrangement is available during target fitting.
design.concrete_initial_source: Wellcome MS.617, Thesaurus ff.1r-32v, fever material ff.32v-35r, additions ff.35r-47v and phlebotomy ff.47v-51v; catalogue gives complete-work boundaries and selected literal incipits, plus a modern Latin edition pointer. An earlier witness of the same editorial branch or a justified shared ancestor would be needed for an historically specific exemplar claim.
independent_information_channels: Collated exact vernacular lexical content across several separately attributed source works supplies named words and language information.
The complete externally fixed pattern of chapter additions, omissions, divisions, inversions and continuous joins supplies nonlocal ordering constraints unavailable from any one passage.
One global whole-word bijection must preserve every recurrence across works and chapters, including ordinary words and content words; it cannot rename each source independently.
design.nonarbitrary_key: Enumerate all joint word-key, source-chapter and admissible boundary assignments over the full fixed scope. Attribute a meaning only when every surviving assignment agrees. A unique chapter-plan fit without a unique lexical key is source-architecture evidence only. Vernacular meaning is not established by a higher generic Italian score.
design.prediction: After discovery fixes the editorial branch and all surviving global keys, reserved complete manuscript records must contain the exact source-specific continuation in the externally fixed order, including a predeclared unusual split or inversion crossing a work boundary. No source chapter may be chosen after the reserved text is read.
design.falsifier: A secure full-record token recurrence or chapter-order contradiction excludes an assignment. Zero assignments refutes the fixed redaction-plus-word-code model. Multiple assignments remain unidentifiable; missing full source text or uncertain record boundaries are missing data; an incomplete solve is not UNSAT.
design.comparison_to_120: IDEA120 allows runs from a fixed source pool. Here the generator is one witnessed editorial plan covering several traditions, with externally attested nontrivial transformations and joins. Adding a work or rearranging chapters is not a free montage operation.
primary_predecessors: IDEA000120: related source-provenance architecture, preserved separately.
GDT211: De balneis variable information packages and failed generic opening specificity; none of its genre/slot scores is reused.
GDT621: corrected complete-context source readings, no target binding; a source-reading precedent rather than this witness or its redaction.
GDT213/GDT215: broad medical mixed-page architecture without an identifying source key.
GDT887: fixed Tacuinum compiler failure; its source equations and target assignments are not repaired.
GDT892: control-capacity stop; its unfinished/unqualified control is not a validation gate for this model.
design.availability: Official catalogue and its explicitly located examples are readable. Full native/diplomatic witness collation, a securely relevant earlier editorial branch, and any target-source correspondence are absent. No manuscript target was nominated or inspected; no original source image was opened in this producer pass.
design.scope: Any later target packet must use only already admitted complete prose records in their actual physical order and the registered alternate readings; f84/f84r remain sealed. It must account for every record in the fixed packet, not only selected matches. Graphics and chapter counts alone cannot identify the source.
design.budget: If selected, first use a 30-minute total checkpoint to establish a finite native source packet and determine whether its distinctive multi-work plan is actually collatable; do not implement a decoder while these inputs are absent. A separate whole-model fit budget must then include complete solving, independent validation and publication.
design.selection_status: Raw unreviewed whole-model source proposal. No direct-descent claim, decoder success, general language identification or authorization to reopen closed routes.
